name: Miranda
note: lazy, polymorphic language that strongly influenced Haskell
typeSystem: Static, strong, Hindley-Milner-based polymorphic type inference with algebraic data types and list comprehensions; one of the first languages to pair lazy evaluation with this style of type system, an approach Haskell was designed to standardise.
runtime: Compiled to combinators and executed by a graph-reduction machine, giving lazy (call-by-need) evaluation throughout the language.

runtimes.name: Graph-reduction machine
runtimes.role: Lazily reduces a shared graph of combinators, only evaluating expressions when their results are actually needed.

compilers.name: mira (Research Software Ltd.)
compilers.role: The original, commercially licensed Miranda compiler and interpreter.

codeExample.caption: Factorial using guarded equations
codeExample.source:
fact n = 1, if n = 0
       = n * fact (n-1), otherwise

main = fact 10
